mods.name: Realm Origins
mods.label: Your story starts here
mods.description: Give your character a name, a past, and a place in the world.
mods.story: Every great story begins with someone. Create a roleplay character through a chapter-based introduction, then carry their history, achievements, and money in a parchment character book.
features: Chapter-based character creation with a live 3D portrait.
Custom occupation, personal history, and a drawn signature.
Roleplay names above players, in TAB, and in normal chat.
A character book, digital wallet, and currency exchange.
mods.firstStep: Create your character when prompted. Press P to open your character book afterwards.
mods.integrations: Requires Origins 0.3.2 and Jupiter 2.3.7 for NeoForge. Origins: Classes 0.3 is optional. Replaces Chronicles RP; keep only one JAR.
